acceptanceCriteria: CAL-V0-127's section carries a cross-reference note to ATR-V0-134 without adding a new CAL requirement
body: Found while building V1-1852 (#1157). ATR-V0-134 makes dispatch status exit 1 with ERROR/MALFORMED on an invalid on-disk config. The leases spec requirement CAL-V0-127 describing dispatch status does not mention this, and CAL-V0 is at its bound, so a reader of CAL-V0-127 cannot learn it.
title: CAL-V0-127 text does not state dispatch status's outcome or exit code on an invalid config; only ATR-V0-134 records it
